# `component-unused`

Changed component has no usages

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `info` |
| **Rule IDs** | `component-unused` |
| **Status** | Planned (M5) |
| **Group** | References and components ([RULES.md section 8](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

A component changed, but no operation uses it.

## Why this default

The change affects no operation (it may be used by other specs or code generators).

## Example

_No example yet: one is added with the rule's test case when the rule is implemented._

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  component-unused: info
```

## How to fix

Nothing to fix; consider removing unused components.
